Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the alteration of health care information.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to alteration of health care information in medicalrecords; and adding a new section to chapter 70.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The accuracy of a patient's medical records is of greatimportance. Under no circumstance shall any health care provider,health care facility, or health carrier alter, distort, change, orotherwise revise the original reporting of the patient's diagnosis,treatment, condition, or prognosis, or the record containing suchdocumentation except to expand or broaden the accuracy of the recordcontent. (2) Amendments, corrections, clarifications, or completions to amedical record must be dated and identified as such. (3) The author of the original record or the author of any changein a record shall be identified. The patient shall be notified of anychange to the record. p. 1 HB 1817 (4) Violations of this section are considered unprofessionalconduct and are subject to discipline under chapter 18.130 RCW.
